Who we are

A young company. Two decades deep.

Blueneck Events Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated in 2022 to build on years of event experience. Our leadership brings close to two decades of core expertise, and our team is made up of seasoned professionals in every event discipline.

We are proud to be Central India's pioneers in conference and corporate event management.

We exist so our clients can focus on the moment, while we take care of the rest.

Before the event

Three desks run registrations, faculty and abstracts.

01Desk 01

Registration

  • Registration format charted and updated daily
  • A dedicated conference number for confirmations and queries
  • Audit-ready sheets for your CA at regular intervals
  • Onsite badges, spot registration, attendance and Medical Council feedback forms, run with the QR agency
02Desk 02

Scientific

  • A dedicated portal for all scientific communication
  • Faculty lists prepared under the Scientific Committee's guidance
  • Invitations first, then detailed session communication
  • One team member as every faculty member's single contact
03Desk 03

Abstracts

  • Submission guidelines charted with the committee
  • A Google Form or similar system for submissions
  • Acknowledgements and acceptances sent by us

How show days run
  • On site a day before set-up, after regular meetings with every vendor and agency
  • A console lead in every hall and preview room, linking hall in-charges with the AV team
  • Stage and backstage run for the inaugural, oration and valedictory
  • Chairpersons receive CVs and schedules for their sessions
  • QR badge scans at every meal give an exact plate count
Associated services

Vendors, spouses, artists and gifts are covered too.

Vendor coordination

  • Local event manager: layouts and separate scopes of work
  • Venue and hotels: regular meetings, and our team mediates on event days
  • AV team: one contact for every session and ceremony
  • Photo and video: Medical Council evidence for credit hours, handed over on a hard disc
  • Travel and tours: local transport and sightseeing

Spouse programmes

  • An itinerary for accompanying persons
  • Activities on site
  • Day tours to local attractions

Artist coordination

  • Artists suggested to suit your programme
  • Technical needs agreed with the AV team
  • Travel, stay and local transfers
  • Backstage arrangements in order

Gifts and merchandise

  • Faculty mementoes
  • Oration certificates and citations
  • Inaugural and valedictory felicitations
  • Delegate and spouse gifts

Signature case study 01

NSICON 2025

73rd Annual National Conference of the Neurological Society of India

Over 13 months, our longest engagement to date, Blueneck ran the conference end to end: registration, scientific sessions, workshops, look and feel, guest hospitality, logistics, entertainment and gifting.

A core team of 6 professionals and 50 managers also delivered 3 entertainment nights and a public awareness Neurothon.

Signature case study 02

WZUSICON 2026, Goa

36th Annual Conference of the Urological Society of India – West Zone

Nine months of planning and four days on ground, at the Goa Marriott. Blueneck ran the conference end to end: registration, scientific halls, exhibition, look and feel, guest hospitality, logistics and every evening engagement.

The conference marks a continuing association with USI – West Zone, following WZUSICON 2023.

What we ran
  • Registration and the scientific programme across halls
  • Exhibition build and sponsor servicing
  • Guest hospitality, travel and on-ground logistics
  • Entertainment, theming and gifting

Directors' message

A message from our directors.

Between us, we have spent nearly six decades at the back of event halls, watching plans become moments. Medical conferences ask the most of that discipline: hundreds of doctors, a scientific clock that cannot slip, and a committee that still has hospitals to run. We built Blueneck so you can hand us everything except the science, and know it will be done.

Radhika Pawar, Mohit Bhargava and Hitesh Panwar
